clips.title: The story
paras: Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle's Head marks the end of a threat to Red Cloud Mesa. The Bristleback leader threatened the young tauren braves, and his head was recovered from deep in Brambleblade Ravine as proof of victory.

The Bristleback quilboar of Brambleblade Ravine have attacked the tribes of Camp Narache. Their chieftain, Sharptusk Thornmantle, urges them on. The tauren seek to protect their homeland in Mulgore with vigilance and strength. Sharptusk's head proves he is dead and warns the surviving quilboar clans against encroaching on the mesa borders.

Brave Windfeather demands Sharptusk's head as a rite of passage for young hunters and tribal defenders. Facing an enemy clever enough to strike back and lead a war band tests a young combatant's martial skill. Presenting the head fulfills that trial and earns the young fighter a reputation among the braves of Red Cloud Mesa.
